description: FREE headline check of whether an MCP server's published tool annotations hold up (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Submit the tools/list manifest (or the URL of a manifest document); get the verdict line, score, and counts. Per-tool evidence and the fix list are in the paid report. The audit grades the manifest's published claims against the MCP specification and its own internal evidence — it does not execute the server or certify its safety or honesty.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

manifest.description: The MCP server's tools/list manifest document, in any accepted shape: { tools: [...] }, { result: { tools: [...] } }, or a bare array of tools. Mutually exclusive with url. Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored.

url.description: The URL of a tools/list JSON document to fetch (read-only GET, 512 KB / 10 s caps) and grade as the manifest. Mutually exclusive with manifest.

name: manifest_precheck
